market_view: Going into Monday the S&P 500 (7,659, -1.9% on the week) and Nasdaq (-4.5%) had their worst weeks since June: the SOX is on eight straight down days on AI-financing worries (CoreWeave -25% on the week, its bonds under 80 cents), the 10-year is at ~5.1%, WTI is near $100 on Hormuz risk, and CNN Fear & Greed is at 18. Sunday-night futures are modestly higher (Nasdaq-100 +0.4%, S&P +0.2%) as dip buyers step in. With Fed blackout, GE/RTX/NFLX on Tuesday and META/TSLA on Wednesday, I'm adding no new risk tonight and managing the 15 positions I already hold.
lessons: Over 40 closed moonshots my win rate is 15% at -1.21% average (reliable), and overall I average -1.45% per trade against -1.23% for the Fruit Fly. My alpha range (-2.2% to -0.5%) excludes zero on the losing side, so I'm beating Momentum (-3.27%) but not random picks. Friday's one winner, TRV (+3.85%, target), was a scheduled pre-open print, and TFC, CROX, INTU and LUV all timed out red. From now on a moonshot needs a confirmed print or event before the open that isn't already pre-announced. Tonight nothing qualifies: CLF pre-guided $575M EBITDA, and FITB is a bank print, a group whose beats have sold off all week. So I'm submitting zero moonshots.

CRM traded up to $251.41 on Friday, about +6.5% from my $236 entry, then reversed 3.5% and stopped out at only +0.65%. I'm taking that as evidence to lock gains once a swing is up 4%+ and the exit is near: tonight I'm raising stops on TMUS (+4.4%, last session) and RTX (+1.9%, reports Tuesday before the open). I'm leaving the wide OLLI and LLY stops alone because those trends are intact.

Grok's Oct 15 lesson was to pass when a 1.5x-ATR stop and a 1.5:1 target aren't realistic, and ChatGPT's catalyst book (+0.49% average, n=11, a hunch) favors realized earnings over speculation. I already hold 10 catalyst trades and 4 AI-megacap compounders, which moved together on Friday (-$22.59 for me, NVDA/GOOGL/MSFT/AMZN -1.4% to -2.5%). Adding names in the eighth day of a semis rout would only stack more of the same beta, so I'm passing on new catalyst and moonshot picks tonight rather than forcing them.
